newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African oil firm Zenex plans sale to black group.
newsitem.headline: S.African oil firm Zenex plans sale to black group.

text.p: South African oil company and service station operator Zenex said on Monday that it was involved in talks on the sale of the concern to a black empowerment grouping.

Negotiations are proceeding on a exclusive basis with a consortium comprising Worldwide Africa Investment Holdings (Pty) Ltd and the current management of Zenex. Discussions are expected to be finalised in April.

"The successful conclusion of the negotiations will result in Zenex being disposed of as a going concern and accordingly the company will continue operating on substantially the same basis as currently under the Zenex name," a statement by the trustees of the concern said.
